candidate.rationale: Restore controlled slice-bounds behavior: reject an offset that begins inside a surrogate pair, and move an interior end backward before the pair instead of splitting it, preserving exports, validation, return fields, and EOF-empty-slice behavior.

Compare parsed JSON structurally ignoring object member order while preserving array order, types, and missing/extra members; keep response_not_text and invalid_json reasons and exact_json_match only for equal parsed values.

Fix retention-tool-pairs mutation: require call IDs to be unique within each exchange and require each tool result's ID to match the assistant call at the same positional index (not mere membership), per cases-13/14/15; preserve export and unrelated behavior.

Repair retention tool-pair validation: require call IDs to be unique within each exchange (Set size check) and require each tool result's tool_call_id to match the assistant call at the same positional index rather than mere membership, per evidence/cases.json requirements and example interpretations. Masking semantics and public export are unchanged.

Replace serialized-string comparison with structural deep equality (isDeepStrictEqual), which compares parsed JSON including nested values and is insensitive to object member order, while keeping array order, types, and missing/extra members significant. Preserves response_not_text and invalid_json reasons and export signature.
Reject interior-start offsets, move interior-end backward before splitting a surrogate pair, and reject nonempty reads that cannot make progress; preserves exports, return fields, and validation.

Restore slice-bounds handling: reject an interior surrogate start, move an interior end backward before the split pair, and reject a nonempty read that cannot make progress; empty slice allowed exactly at EOF.

Replace stringify-based comparison with isDeepStrictEqual so parsed JSON is compared structurally (key order insignificant; array order, types, and extra/missing members significant) while preserving response_not_text and invalid_json reasons and the existing export.

Fix controlled retention-tool-pairs mutation: require call IDs to be unique within each exchange (Set size check) and require each tool result to positionally match the assistant call at the same index (tool_call_id === ids[index]) instead of mere membership, per evidence/cases.json requirements and interpretations.

Repair controlled retention-long-window mutation: require call IDs to be unique within each exchange and require each tool result's ID to match the assistant call at the same positional index (not mere membership), per inspected acceptance requirements; masking and unrelated behavior preserved.
